        <commentText>Explanatory Note:

This Amendment No. 2 amends and supplements the Schedule 13D originally filed with the Commission on May 22, 2026, as amended by Amendment No. 1 filed with the Commission on June 26, 2026 (the Original Schedule 13D) and is being filed by Eclipse Ventures Fund I, L.P. (Eclipse SPV II), Eclipse SPV II GP, LLC (Eclipse SPV II GP), Eclipse SPV XIII, L.P. The Reporting Entities and Mr. Susan are collectively referred to as the Reporting Persons. The Reporting Persons expressly disclaim status as a group for purposes of this Schedule 13D. The agreement among the Reporting Persons to file jointly in accordance with the provisions of Rule 13d-1(k)(1) under the Act is attached to the Original Schedule 13D as Exhibit 1. Only those items that are hereby reported are amended; all other items reported in the Original Schedule 13D remain unchanged.
